[research area Methods and Algorithms](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/?domain=Methods%20and%20Algorithms) ,[research area Tools, Platforms, Frameworks](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/?domain=Tools%2C%20Platforms%2C%20Frameworks)


Continual-learning agents are systems of models, harnesses, and memory operating over long multi-session horizons. Evaluating and training them requires interleaving tasks with agent-side events such as session stop and start, crons, and memory consolidation. [AgentBuilder: Exploring Scaffolds for Prototyping User Experiences of Interface Agents](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/agentbuilder)


January 9, 2026


[research area Human-Computer Interaction](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/?domain=Human-Computer%20Interaction)


Interface agents powered by generative AI models (referred to as “agents”) can automate actions based on user commands. An important aspect of developing agents is their user experience (i.e., agent experience). There is a growing need to provide scaffolds for a broader set of individuals beyond AI engineers to prototype agent experiences, since they can contribute valuable perspectives to designing agent experiences.
